# _Ghana Djembe Drum_

\\n

## Tweneboa Wood/White wood  13" / 330mm.

\\nThe Ghanaian Djembe has an impressive bass, tone, slap definition.  This is a light wood drum. A great drum for children, travelers, or adults wanting an affordable first Djembe with an authentic African sound.  **\\n**
